name: Agent Chat
description: A resumable agent session provider and chat board for the installed Claude and Codex CLIs.
author: Persephone

settings.label: Claude executable
settings.description: Optional absolute path to the installed claude executable. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH.

settings.label: Claude default model
settings.description: Optional Claude model id. Empty uses the model from your Claude Code settings, or Opus.

settings.label: Claude default effort
settings.description: Optional effort supported by the selected Claude model. Empty uses the effort from your Claude Code settings, or medium.

settings.label: Codex executable
settings.description: Optional absolute path to the installed codex executable. Leave empty to resolve it from PATH.

settings.label: Codex default model
settings.description: Optional Codex model id. Empty uses the default from Codex model/list.

settings.label: Codex default effort
settings.description: Optional reasoning effort supported by the selected Codex model. Empty uses that model's default.

settings.label: Cross-board permission ceiling
settings.description: Maximum permission mode for every consumer board. Persephone's own MCP tools are exempt: they are pre-approved for every session, so this ceiling gates native tools such as shell commands and file writes, not Persephone tool calls.
